text.printed:
Quickstrike. Villainous.
When Revealed: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for Death Spiral and reveal it.
[star] Forced Interrupt: When Torment attacks a friendly character, if you control or have in your hand an ally or Persona support with the same classification as that character (identity-specific, aspect, or basic), cancel that attack, then discard that card instead.
